# Have you been abroad 330 days yet?

> Free calculator for the Form 2555 physical presence test: enter your stays abroad and see your best 12-month window, how many of the 330 days you have, how many days you can still spend elsewhere, and the prorated foreign earned income exclusion. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
